strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Disk Content Wipe via Direct Access and Overwrite

analytics.name: Analytic 0882
analytics.guidance: Processes attempting raw disk access via \\.\PhysicalDrive paths, abnormal file I/O to MBR/boot sectors, or loading of third-party drivers (e.g., RawDisk) that enable disk overwrite. Correlate process creation, privilege usage, and disk modification events within a short time window.

tuning.description: Backup, forensics, or imaging tools may perform legitimate raw disk access — requires tuning per environment.
Correlation threshold for process execution, driver load, and raw disk writes.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: Raw disk writes targeting \\.\PhysicalDrive* or MBR locations

analytics.name: Analytic 0883
analytics.guidance: Execution of destructive utilities (dd, shred, wipe) targeting block devices, or processes invoking syscalls to directly overwrite /dev/sd* or /dev/nvme* partitions. Correlate abnormal file write attempts with shell process execution and block device access.

tuning.description: Exclude removable drives or designated partitions that may be overwritten during maintenance.
Tune detection for pseudorandom write patterns to reduce false positives during high-volume I/O.

log_sources.name: auditd:EXECVE
log_sources.channel: Execution of dd, shred, or wipe with arguments targeting block devices

analytics.name: Analytic 0884
analytics.guidance: Abnormal invocation of diskutil or asr with destructive flags (eraseDisk, zeroDisk), or low-level IOKit calls that overwrite raw disk content. Detect correlation between elevated process execution and disk erase operations.

tuning.description: Provisioning workflows may legitimately use diskutil/asr — whitelist by user or system context.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: diskutil eraseDisk/zeroDisk or asr restore with destructive flags

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: IOKit raw disk write activity targeting physical devices

analytics.name: Analytic 0885
analytics.guidance: Execution of CLI commands erasing file systems or storage (erase flash:, format disk, erase nvram:). Detect authentication events followed by destructive commands within the same privileged session.

tuning.description: Tune to exclude approved maintenance performed by authorized administrators.
Expand or narrow destructive command coverage depending on vendor-specific syntax.

log_sources.name: networkdevice:cli
log_sources.channel: erase flash:, erase nvram:, format disk

log_sources.name: networkdevice:syslog
log_sources.channel: Privileged login followed by destructive command sequence
